name: learning-pulse
description: A learning management system with analytics

scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && npx nodemon server.js" "cd frontend && PORT=3001 npx react-scripts start"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.frontend: cd frontend && PORT=3001 DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true npx react-scripts start
